reports.headline: A Woman in White at the Old Chapel
reports.body: {name} saw a tall woman in a wedding veil standing in the doorway of the old chapel {dir} of the village {dist}, quite still, at midnight. When {they} looked again she was standing behind {them}. {name} has not slept since.

reports.headline: Weeping From the Chapel
reports.body: Travellers on the road {dir} of here {dist} report a woman weeping inside the old chapel, then screaming, loud enough that the windows rattled. The chapel has been empty since the wedding that never happened there, years ago.

reports.headline: Rotten Flowers on the Chapel Steps
reports.body: Every morning there are dead flowers on the steps of the old chapel {dir} of the village {dist}, a bride's bouquet gone black. {name} cleared them away twice; the third time {they} heard the doors creak open behind {them} and ran.
